I am a **lecturer (Asisten Ahli)** in the [Department of Electrical Engineering](https://teknik-elektro.fst.unja.ac.id/) at the Faculty of Science and Technology, [Universitas Jambi](https://www.unja.ac.id/). I work at the intersection of **Artificial Intelligence**, **Machine Learning**, **Pattern Recognition**, and **Predictive Systems** — applying computational methods to real-world problems in agriculture, health, and industry.

Before joining academia, I spent several years as a **Data Scientist** — most recently at **Alfagift** (Global Loyalty Indonesia) and previously at **kumparan** — building data products, forecasting systems, and machine-learning pipelines at scale.

I hold a **Master of Computer Science (M.Kom.)** from Universitas Indonesia and a **Bachelor of Computer Science (S.Komp.)** from IPB University. My research is published in Scopus-indexed and SINTA-accredited venues, and my work is tracked on [Google Scholar](https://sinta.kemdiktisaintek.go.id/authors/profile/6931115/?view=googlescholar), [Scopus](https://www.scopus.com/), and [SINTA](https://sinta.kemdiktisaintek.go.id/authors/profile/6931115).

## Selected Research

::: {.callout-note}
**Research focus.** I apply computational intelligence to practical problems in agriculture, health, industry, and public administration.
:::

- **Pattern Recognition** — deep learning and feature-based recognition applied to scanned documents, fish counting, remote sensing scenes, and medical imagery.
- **Predictive Systems** — time-series forecasting with SARIMA and LSTM for energy exports and stock prices; predictive analytics with machine learning.
- **Machine Learning & Clustering** — K-means and hierarchical clustering for customer segmentation, provincial grouping, and hotspot analysis.
- **Expert & Intelligent Systems** — rule-based and computational systems design for domain-specific decision support.

## Selected Projects

- **Automated Fish Counter** — an embedded system integrated with an Android device for automated fish measurement, counting, and sorting. [GitHub](https://github.com/akhiyarwaladi/Automated-Fish-Counter) · [Devpost](https://devpost.com/software/automated-fish-counter)
- **IoT FST Dashboard** — web dashboard for monitoring IoT sensor data from the Faculty of Science and Technology. [GitHub](https://github.com/akhiyarwaladi/iot_fst_dashboard)
- **Fire Spot** — agglomerative hierarchical clustering of hotspots in Bangka Belitung Islands Province. [GitHub](https://github.com/akhiyarwaladi/fire_spot)
- **ML Tutorials** — teaching notebooks covering machine-learning fundamentals. [GitHub](https://github.com/akhiyarwaladi/ml_tutorial)

More on the [Projects page](projects/index.qmd).
